title: GreyNoise Visualizer and SANS ISC manual pivots (batch p2-G02-3: greynoise_community, isc_dshield)
notes: Manual follow-up pages of greynoise_community (P148 cond 7: viz.greynoise.io/ips/{ip}) and isc_dshield (P151: the ISC IP page). Checked 2026-11-26 from a datacenter egress: viz.greynoise.io answers 403 to scripts and isc.sans.edu redirects scripted page requests to /blockme.html, so both are manual links only (antibot) and never automated. LeakIX pages redirect to /auth/login (a LeakIX account is needed), so they are not in this pack: the leakix module cites them as references only.
